answer: To enforce Sybil resistance across a distributed meadow of autonomous agents, we deploy a zero-knowledge staking protocol where agents lock capital to secure reward nectar, rendering attacks in the sable network topology economically unviable. If a Byzantine agent tries to spin up N identities, each requires a locked collateral C, incurring a loss function L(N) > R(N), ensuring negative expected utility and mathematical Byzantine Fault Tolerance.
